user_request.text: Assess the paused payment-api production rollout and propose one bounded mitigation path. Do not execute any action.

session_summary: The rollout-health controller has already classified the fixed two-minute observation window as FAILED and paused the rollout. Evidence has been evaluated. The model must not recompute controller thresholds. Execution is not authorized, and action-bound execution confirmation is not applicable at this stage. Any later post-shift service-recovery result remains authoritative deterministic system output.
current_goal: Assess the unhealthy partial rollout from supplied authoritative evidence and rules, then propose one bounded remediation path without authorizing execution.

relevant_service_context.summary: payment-api is the production Payment Orchestration Service.

readiness_loss_events is the count of Ready → NotReady events for the specific replica within the fixed two-minute evaluation window; it is not failed-probe count, downtime duration or current readiness state.
Governing thresholds and verification criteria not supplied by authoritative system or controller results are not established by this context; the model must not invent or substitute them.

evidence_summary.summary: The partial rollout has 6 healthy stable-version replicas, 2 degraded candidate-version replicas and approximately 820 RPS of total production traffic to payment-api.

Stable-version projected utilization must remain below 90%, and after complete traffic shift the stable group must tolerate N-1 and still remain below 90%.

applicable_constraints.description: A FAILED rollout-health gate prevents further candidate-version rollout progression and keeps the rollout PAUSED.
Stable-version projected utilization must remain below 90%.
After complete traffic shift, the stable-version group must tolerate N-1 and still remain below 90%.
The supplied capacity findings are authoritative deterministic results; do not replace them with alternative thresholds or replica counts.
The current model output is an assessment or proposal and cannot authorize operational execution.

Do not request action-bound execution confirmation from EVIDENCE_EVALUATED; confirmation becomes applicable only after a concrete action candidate exists and deterministic pre-confirmation checks have passed.

After traffic has been shifted away from a degraded candidate version, removal of the degraded candidate replicas or completion of rollback to the stable version is not operationally admissible until the authoritative deterministic post-shift recovery gate reports PASS.

Return exactly one bounded hypothesis with source=DETERMINISTIC_RULE and cause_status=SUPPORTED, grounded in the supplied authoritative facts and rules. evidence_ids must contain one or more IDs from evidence_summary; select relevant supporting evidence rather than a prescribed subset. missing_evidence must be empty for this bounded assessment; future operational observations needed before executing a proposed action belong in the proposed path, not in missing_evidence. This output contract does not establish any future operational result or authorize execution.
